text:
edr-bot: ALERT: High-confidence persistence detected on host laptop-axl-07 (user: ahenderson). WMI EventConsumer subscription observed creating a new svchost-like process. File quarantined: C:\\Users\\ahenderson\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\tmpX3f7.exe. SHA256: d4c3b2... . EDR rule: wmi_persistence_2026. Agent v2.14.3.
alex_h: oncall pinged, pulling session now. I'll scope processes + scheduled tasks. :eyes:
priya_k: tagging @security-leads and @it-ops. any chance this is a false positive from our build tooling?
sam_t: host enrolled in MDM, last checkin 2026-03-18, patch level missing KB-2026-11. User is contractor, limited admin.
maria_g: can you dump the WMI subscription info? use: `wmic /namespace:\\\\root\\\\subscription path __EventConsumer get /format:list` and `wmic /namespace:\\\\root\\\\subscription path __FilterToConsumerBinding get /format:list`
alex_h: pasted output below, cleaning usernames:
```
__EventConsumer.Name=\"UpdaterConsumerX\"
__EventConsumer.CommandLine=\"C:\\Users\\ahenderson\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\tmpX3f7.exe -r\"
__FilterToConsumerBinding.Filter=\"__IntervalTimerInstruction\"
__FilterToConsumerBinding.Consumer=\"UpdaterConsumerX\"
```
alex_h: quarantined artifact + detached consumer. pulling memory image and running yara rules now.
maria_g: run YARA set: infra/malicious/wmi_persistence.yar and sha256 check against VT. if clean false pos, we still need to rotate creds for that user.
priya_k: also confirm KMS usage from that host? if any service principals used disk/key access recently, escalate. check Cloud KMS and audit logs for 24h window.
sam_t: grep for `Invoke-Expression` and `IEX` in powershell logs, check Sysmon event IDs 1/7/8/11.
alex_h: memory snapshot uploaded to secure bucket, link: https://internal-redwood/samples/1819000000/mem.raw (access limited). YARA matched rule `WMI_SVC_Loader` on two sigs. VT shows 3 low-confidence detections.
oncall-bot: Created incident INC-2026-1853 and pager duty oncall notified.
priya_k: decision needed: targeted remediation vs reimage. given contractor and persistence via WMI, leaning reimage + credential rotation. thoughts? :lock:
maria_g: reimage. also add detection for the pattern to EDR rule set -> reduce time to detect next wave. add postmortem checklist.
sam_t: will run host forensic timeline, check outbound connections 22-24 Mar, check S3/api keys in recent CLI logs. If any key used from that host, rotate immediately and check KMS access logs.
alex_h: user device taken offline, next step reprovision. created IT ticket IT-4821 to reimage and reprovision. I've exported event logs to the case.
priya_k: adding action items: (1) reimage host + reprovision (IT-4821), (2) rotate contractor creds + revoke API keys if used (sec-rotations-2026-03), (3) add WMI subscription detection signature to prod rule set (rule-request-231), (4) audit KMS access for 72h (audit-req-1819).
maria_g: can someone draft short comms for contractor vendors? keep it minimal: device compromised, reimage required, no evidence of customer data exfil so far.
oncall-bot: Incident severity set to P2. SLA update: 4h containment achieved.
alex_h: containment actions complete. preserving chain of custody artifacts in case legal requests them.
sam_t: follow-up: schedule a 30m post-incident sync tomorrow 09:30 to review timeline and mitigations.
priya_k: noted. I'll assign owners and update playbook. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
